name: Ганаа
ageNote: EP1: GANAA 46, KAMAZ trucker, husband of Tsetsegmaa, father of Altan. Wrist bite and red line; turns at birthday. EP2 mentions him; he is not shown there.
faceDesign: Production revision of ganaa-eye-final: lids opened for readable irises, hooded character retained, lighter eye bags, cooler skin

name: Ирина Ковалева
ageNote: EP1 hook/setup: IRINA 54, Russian dialogue, cigarette, cassette dictaphone and leather satchel. Bible names epidemiologist Irina Kovaleva; not seen after EP1.
faceDesign: Long lean rectangular face, deep-set grey eyes, prominent bridge and thin wide lips

name: Даша
ageNote: EP1: DASHA 24, Russian hitchhiker with stained scarf on left forearm; becomes flushed runner and dies at the fuel-pump fire.
faceDesign: Angular diamond cheekbones, pointed chin, narrow bridge, wider-set blue-green eyes and full bow lips

name: Хүрэл
ageNote: EP1 truck-stop: HÜREL, cook in his 50s with stained apron. Eaten and explicitly stays dead; not a confirmed infected survivor.
faceDesign: Short round face, full cheeks, broad upturned nose, heavy soft lids and smaller full mouth

name: Цэцэгмаа
ageNote: EP1 party: TSETSEGMAA 30, Ganaa’s wife, called Цэцгээ. EP2 ER: blood down dress, reports the attack; no confirmed bite of her own.
faceDesign: Wide high cheekbones, tapered lower face, low straight bridge, level almond lids and defined lip bow

name: Дулмаа
ageNote: EP1 party: DULMAA 65, Ganaa’s mother-in-law. Notices his wrist; exact infection and later fate are unspecified.
faceDesign: Broad older face, soft jaw, downward nose tip, hooded asymmetrical lids and thin downturned lips

name: Сүхээ
ageNote: EP1: drunk neighbour SÜKHEE; EP2 only mentions Ganaa biting him and Dagva naming him as attacker. Bite exposure is confirmed; no second on-screen episode assigned.
faceDesign: Long rectangular head, projecting chin, convex nose, unequal upper-lid folds and thin upper lip

name: Алтан
ageNote: EP1 birthday: ALTAN is explicitly a three-year-old girl wearing a paper crown. Her fate after the cut is not established.
faceDesign: Toddler round cheeks and short button nose; echoes her mother without adult facial creases
